scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP message with Return Sales Order notification (giic_OrderTypeCode__c = 'POR')

scenarios.expected_outcome: Router default branch SequenceFlow_110 is selected, terminating at EndEvent_11 with escalation code RoutingConditionNotMet

scenarios.name: Mapping Failure Triggers Exception Subprocess
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP message triggering Sales Order route with corrupted data causing Test_Mapping runtime failure
scenarios.expected_outcome: Exception caught by StartEvent_92, CallActivity_97 restores original body from property.InputPayload, CallActivity_100 logs raw payload, and flow terminates with ErrorEndEvent
scenarios.validates: SubProcess_91, StartEvent_92, CallActivity_97 (Property Enricher), CallActivity_100 (Log Payload Script), EndEvent_95

scenarios.name: SOAP Adapter Security / Authorization Failure
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP HTTP request missing required ESBMessaging.send role credentials or invalid signature
scenarios.expected_outcome: Inbound adapter rejects message with HTTP 401/403 before integration process starts
scenarios.validates: MessageFlow_114 inbound security configuration and userRole enforcement

scenarios.name: Boundary Payload Size Validation
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP request exceeding maximumBodySize limit of 40MB configured on SOAP sender channel
scenarios.expected_outcome: SOAP CXF runtime raises payload size limit exception, rejecting execution at adapter level

def evaluate_mock_cpi_flow(request_body, request_headers):
    auth = request_headers.get("Authorization", "")
    if not auth or "invalid" in auth:
        return 401, {"Content-Type": "text/xml"}, "<soap:Fault><faultcode>soap:Client</faultcode><faultstring>Unauthorized</faultstring></soap:Fault>"

    if len(request_body.encode("utf-8")) > (40 * 1024 * 1024):
        return 500, {"Content-Type": "text/xml"}, "<soap:Fault><faultcode>soap:Server</faultcode><faultstring>Maximum body size 40MB exceeded</faultstring></soap:Fault>"

    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(request_body)
    except ET.ParseError as e:
        # SubProcess_91 execution simulation
        resp_headers = {
            "Content-Type": "text/xml",
            "X-SAP-Error-Subprocess": "SubProcess_91",
            "X-SAP-InputPayload-Preserved": "true",
            "X-SAP-Logged-Attachment": "Payload"
        }
        return 500, resp_headers, f"<soap:Fault><faultcode>soap:Server</faultcode><faultstring>Mapping/Parsing Error: {str(e)}</faultstring></soap:Fault>"

    order_type_elem = root.find(".//ns2:giic_OrderTypeCode__c", NAMESPACES)
    order_code = order_type_elem.text if order_type_elem is not None else ""

    # Simulate CallActivity_4 property and header assignment
    headers_assigned = {
        "Region": "NA",
        "Country": "US",
        "BusinessObject": "SalesOrder",
        "Sender": "Glovia",
        "TimeStamp": "2026-10-14T10:00:00Z"
    }

    # Router ExclusiveGateway_80 condition checks
    if order_code in ["YORB", "YICB", "MNZ", "PLM"]:
        # Route SalesOrder -> CallActivity_102 -> CallActivity_13 -> EndEvent_2
        resp_headers = {
            "Content-Type": "text/xml",
            "X-SAP-Route-Taken": "SalesOrder",
            "X-SAP-End-Event": "EndEvent_2",
            "X-SAP-CustomHeader-Country": headers_assigned["Country"],
            "X-SAP-CustomHeader-Region": headers_assigned["Region"],
            "X-SAP-CustomHeader-BusinessObject": headers_assigned["BusinessObject"],
            "X-SAP-CustomHeader-Sender": headers_assigned["Sender"]
        }
        return 202, resp_headers, "<Ack><Status>Processed_SalesOrder</Status></Ack>"

    elif order_code == "POR":
        # Route ReturnSalesOrder -> CallActivity_71 -> EndEvent_9
        resp_headers = {
            "Content-Type": "text/xml",
            "X-SAP-Route-Taken": "SO Return create",
            "X-SAP-End-Event": "EndEvent_9",
            "X-SAP-CustomHeader-Country": headers_assigned["Country"],
            "X-SAP-CustomHeader-Region": headers_assigned["Region"],
            "X-SAP-CustomHeader-BusinessObject": headers_assigned["BusinessObject"],
            "X-SAP-CustomHeader-Sender": headers_assigned["Sender"]
        }
        return 202, resp_headers, "<Ack><Status>Processed_ReturnSalesOrder</Status></Ack>"

    else:
        # Default branch SequenceFlow_110 -> EndEvent_11 (EscalationEndEvent)
        resp_headers = {
            "Content-Type": "text/xml",
            "X-SAP-Route-Taken": "Default",
            "X-SAP-End-Event": "EndEvent_11",
            "X-SAP-Escalation-Code": "RoutingConditionNotMet"
        }
        return 422, resp_headers, "<Escalation><ErrorCode>RoutingConditionNotMet</ErrorCode></Escalation>"


@responses.activate
def test_tc_so_01_sales_order_happy_path(valid_sales_order_xml, headers_setup):
    def callback(request):
        status, resp_headers, body = evaluate_mock_cpi_flow(request.body, request.headers)
        return (status, resp_headers, body)

    responses.add_callback(
        responses.POST,
        SIMULATED_CPI_ENDPOINT,
        callback=callback,
        content_type="text/xml"
    )

    session = requests.Session()
    response = session.post(SIMULATED_CPI_ENDPOINT, data=valid_sales_order_xml, headers=headers_setup)

    assert response.status_code == 202
    assert response.headers.get("X-SAP-Route-Taken") == "SalesOrder"
    assert response.headers.get("X-SAP-End-Event") == "EndEvent_2"
    assert response.headers.get("X-SAP-CustomHeader-BusinessObject") == "SalesOrder"
    assert response.headers.get("X-SAP-CustomHeader-Sender") == "Glovia"
    assert "<Status>Processed_SalesOrder</Status>" in response.text

risks.consequence: If mapping or script execution fails downstream and the original request payload is not preserved, operators cannot reconstruct or replay failed sales transactions.
risks.mitigation: Enricher CallActivity_4 caches raw body into ${property.InputPayload} at start, and CallActivity_97 in SubProcess_91 restores and attaches it using Log_Payload script.

risks.consequence: Orders with new, unconfigured, or altered OrderTypeCode values are neither processed nor tracked, causing silent business loss and order fulfillment delays.
risks.mitigation: ExclusiveGateway_80 routes non-matching messages to default SequenceFlow_110 into EscalationEndEvent EndEvent_11 with explicit ErrorCode RoutingConditionNotMet.

risks.risk: Disconnected Pipeline Artifacts in BPMN Model
risks.consequence: CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier extracting OrganizationId) and CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) are orphaned nodes in the BPMN XML without sequence flow connections, leading to dead configuration or skipped validations.
risks.mitigation: Integration unit suite identifies uncalled artifacts and asserts routing logic behavior independently to verify whether routing relies on script evaluation or direct XPath expressions.

risks.risk: Receiver Service Timeout and Lack of Retry on Endpoints
risks.consequence: Network timeouts communicating with REST receivers (Participant_2 / Participant_112) could cause duplicate order creations or lost acknowledgments.
risks.mitigation: Exception subprocess catches connectivity faults, writes MPL audit attachments, and propagates standard SOAP Fault to sender to trigger upstream retry.

uncovered_paths: BPMN diagram contains orphaned/unlinked nodes: CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) and CallActivity_86 (XPath Content Modifier). Because there are no sequence flows connected to these activities in Process_1, runtime execution of these nodes does not occur in standard message lifecycle.
coverage_recommendations: Re-link CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86 into the main sequence flow before ExclusiveGateway_80, or remove them from the iFlow bundle if replaced by parameter expressions.
Deploy integration test scenarios validating externalized parameter resolutions for {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}} and {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}} across all SAP landscape tiers.
